name: cmmc-readiness
description: Get a defense supplier ready for a CMMC 2.0 Level 2 assessment. Three deterministic stdlib scripts: an SPRS scorer that weights all 110 NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 requirements per 32 CFR 170.24 and blocks gaps that can never go on a POA&M; a POA&M closeout tracker that checks every deferred gap against the 180-day Conditional status deadline and the annual affirmation calendar; and a scope classifier that sorts the asset inventory into the 170.19 categories and blocks on assets missing from the SSP or cloud providers holding CUI without FedRAMP. Ships cs-cmmc-assessor agent, /cs-cmmc-readiness and /cs-sprs-score commands, 3 cited references and a readiness sign-off.
